OpenCascade's default-precision area (the JSON's, build123d's Face.area) is off its own converged area: BRepGProp.SurfaceProperties at eps 1e-10 gives 13.080647750. The face is a sphere patch (R 5) reaching a pole and bounded by a B-spline edge; the file has no pcurves (OpenCascade projects them on reading). Green's theorem on the exact sphere, -R^2 ∮ sin v du, gives 13.080647750 along OpenCascade's pcurves and 13.080630478 along the foot points of the edges' 3D curves, which is the region haecceity integrates; the two differ only by the edges straying from the projected pcurves within their tolerance (up to 1.8e-5 mm).
